zh: 窗口每次只移出一个元素、移入一个元素，适合维护一个按数值计数的结构，再在其中找第 k 小。
把数值离散化后用树状数组记录窗口内每个值的个数；第 k 小就是前缀计数首次达到 k 的位置，可以在树状数组上用二进制倍增以 O(log n) 找到。
排序去重得到值表，先把前 m 个元素加入树状数组；对每个窗口起点（第一个之后先删 a[start−1]、再加 a[start+m−1]），从不超过值个数的最大二的幂步长开始，若跳过去后的计数仍小于剩余目标就跳过去并扣除；最终位置的下一个值即答案，按窗口顺序输出。
en: Each slide removes one element and adds one, which suits a structure counting elements by value, in which the k-th smallest is then located.

Compress the values and keep, in a Fenwick tree, how many elements of each value are in the window; the k-th smallest is where the prefix count first reaches k, found by binary lifting on the tree in O(log n).

Sort and deduplicate the values, and insert the first m elements; for each window start (after the first, remove a[start-1] and add a[start+m-1]), start from the largest power of two not exceeding the number of values, and jump whenever the count after the jump is still below the remaining target, subtracting it; the value just after the final position is the answer, printed in window order.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Compress the values and maintain the frequency of each value in the current window with a Fenwick tree. Use binary lifting to find the position where the prefix frequency first reaches k; when sliding, remove the old element and add the new one.

## Proof of correctness

Initially the Fenwick tree holds exactly the frequencies of the first window, and one removal plus one insertion per step keeps this invariant. The compressed coordinate of the k-th smallest value is the coordinate where the cumulative frequency first reaches k; binary lifting finds the largest prefix whose cumulative count is still below k, so the next coordinate is exactly right. The frequencies of repeated elements count every occurrence.

## Complexity

Time O(n log n), space O(n).
